Oracle Faces Claims Over Data Centre Payments

Oracle is facing scrutiny over its obligations to pay data centre investors, with questions arising about the company's ability to deliver on AI data centres. A 'force majeure' notice issued by Oracle has prompted these concerns. The company is reportedly battling to delay payments related to its $165 billion data centre projects. Investors are to be paid even if a data centre site lacks electricity.
